verdict.rationale: Although OpenClaw is itself an agent/assistant, its docs explicitly ship a server mode: `openclaw mcp serve` runs OpenClaw as an MCP server and exposes its channel conversations over MCP, which a probe confirms as an official MCP server page. Client-side MCP docs (connecting to other MCP servers) are not credited here. Missing for 10: detail on the tools and resources exposed, transport and auth setup for connecting agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the server mode.
